notes: Not automated: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters and that Character will not become active in your opponent's next Refresh Phase. Then, if your opponent has 2 or more rested Characters, your Leader gains +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
